title: Autopay Courtesy Days on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Payoff Quotes
content:
**Autopay courtesy.** On a customer payoff quote for a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, a customer who paid by autopay has quote interest days after the maturity date not charged. The count is the balloon payments posted through the autopay ACH channel in the 12 calendar months ending on the quote date.

| Autopay payments posted in the 12 months | Quote interest days after maturity not charged |
|---|---|
| At least 10 | 2 |
| At least 6 but fewer than 10 | 1 |
| Fewer than 6 | None |

Payments through other channels are not counted. A window of 12 calendar months ending on the quote date takes in the dates on or before the quote date that fall fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.

*Hypothetical:* 6 autopay payments in the window: 1 day.
